I love talking to folks about science! Below are some organizations that I have been involved with. Please explore the pages below or send me an email if you are interested in an educational event hosted by one of these groups. We cater to audiences of a wide range of ages and backgrounds. 

##### [Life Science Cafe](https://sci-stories.org/life-science-cafe/): Monthly talks and Q&A sessions with scientists.  

##### [The Fernald Club](https://www.instagram.com/umassfernaldclub/): UMass Entomology Club; we share insect science with local students and other groups. 

##### For more information about pollinators:

[UMass Extension Pollinator Website](https://ag.umass.edu/resources/pollinators) <br/>
[UMass Extension Pollinator Facebook Page](https://www.facebook.com/UMassExtPollinators) <br/>

[Xerces Society for Invertebrate Conservation](https://www.xerces.org/)
